presets.title: Desktop CO2 laser (Glowforge Pro class)
sources: Glowforge Pro tech specs: 495 x 279 mm cutting area; materials up to 1/2 in, 1/4 in through the pass-through slot (6.35 mm used here)
presets.notes: Machine-class data from published specs; CO2 cutting depth varies widely with tube, lens and air assist, so treat the maximum thicknesses as typical, not guaranteed.
